meta.title: Donations
meta.description: Every donation, its receipt and its money.

adminDonations.title: Donations
adminDonations.lead: Every online donation, newest first. Donors' names and emails are personal data: open them only to answer for the money.

denied.title: Only finance can see donations
denied.body: Your account doesn't have the finance role.

adminDonations.limited: Showing the newest {count}. Narrow the dates to see older ones.

detail.name: Name
detail.wallNoName: On the wall without a name
detail.noReceipt: No receipt: the donation hasn't been received.

link.title: Receipt link
link.lead: Make a new 7-day link to the receipt, for you to open or pass on. It isn't emailed to anyone, and older links keep their own expiry.
link.cancelled: The receipt is cancelled, so no new link can be made.

refund.title: Refund
refund.lead: Ask for everything left of this donation back. Another finance user approves it, and the money goes back to the card or account it came from.

reason.label: Why
reason.hint: Up to 500 characters. Finance reads it before approving.

refund.requested: Refund asked for. It waits for another finance user to approve it.

decided.approved: Refund approved. It goes to the payment service now.

errors.reason_required: Say why the donation is refunded.
errors.not_refundable: This donation has no money left to refund.
errors.refund_in_progress: A refund of this donation is already in progress.
errors.same_person: You asked for this refund, so another finance user must decide it.
errors.not_requested: This refund is no longer waiting for a decision.
errors.note_required: Write a note to reject it.
errors.not_rejectable: This refund can no longer be rejected.
errors.failed: Something went wrong and nothing changed. Try again.
errors.cancellation_refund_required: The competition was cancelled, so this refund must be paid.

offline.title: Record offline donation
offline.lead: Record money already received by cheque, bank transfer or cash. A receipt is numbered and the donation is posted to the ledger.
offline.referenceHint: Cheque number, transfer reference (UTR), or FOA cash receipt number.
offline.name: Donor or contact person’s full name
offline.panHint: 10 characters. Needed while 80G is on. Stored encrypted.
offline.proofHint: Upload a PDF or photo (PNG, JPEG or WebP), up to 10 MB. Only finance can open it after the malware scan.
offline.adult: The donor declared they are 18 or over.
offline.indian: The donor declared this is their own Indian-source money.
offline.proofUnavailable: The proof is not available yet or did not pass its scan.
